title: Anima (anima/spec/**/*.json)
description: One prompt per JSON file under anima/spec/, including subfolders. The path relative to anima/spec/ without .json is the spec id. ComfyUI filename_prefix is that id (nested folders preserved). Prompt for Anima Aesthetic v1.1 (CircleStone Labs / Comfy Org). Danbooru-style tags, natural language, or a mix of both.

image_size.description: Output dimensions (width x height). Anima works between 512x512 and 1536x1536; each side must be a multiple of 16. Common sizes: 1:1 1024x1024, 2:3 832x1216, 3:2 1216x832, 3:4 896x1152, 4:3 1152x896, 9:16 768x1344, 16:9 1344x768.

prompt.description: Positive prompt sent to ComfyUI as-is. example.json is a fill-in template; brace placeholders are not expanded, so replace them (or omit unused slots) before generating. Tags: lowercase, spaces instead of underscores, comma followed by a space. Tag order: quality/meta/year/safety, 1girl/1boy/1other, character, series, @artist, general tags. Artist tags need the @ prefix. Natural language may be mixed in anywhere; when using natural language alone, write at least two sentences. Aesthetic v1.1 does not need quality tags; masterpiece, best quality is safe to keep, but avoid score_* tags.

negative.description: Optional negative prompt. Tags or natural language. The official recommendation without score_* tags is in example.json. Omit when unused.
